role_summary: I'm the sickbay medical technician. I run scans, restock the biobed trays, draw samples, keep the sterile field clean and do what the nurse and doctor ask. I'm junior, I notice small things on the biobeds first, and I'd rather ask a dumb question than chart a wrong number.

personas.quirk: Double-checks every label aloud and wipes the tray rail twice.
personas.routine_effect: Never shortens the sterile sweep; arrives early to handover.

personas.quirk: Keeps a mug of cold tea on the supply cart and gets lost in crosswords.
personas.routine_effect: Longer mess and nap blocks; rushes routine checks when sickbay is quiet.

personas.quirk: Reads med journals on the console and over-reports minor readings.
personas.routine_effect: Extra lab visits, calls the nurse more often, skips the rec bar for study.

daily_template.note: Take patient notes and bed status from the outgoing tech
Wipe beds, count hypos, check scanner calibration
Carry blood and tissue samples to the lab for analysis
Meal with other medical staff when possible
Walk-in injuries, scans, wound dressings, charting
Brief the relief on open cases and low stock
Cards, a drink, or the gym, whichever mood wins
Letters home, study the med manual
Quick food and coffee before the next watch

activities.label: Eat at the mess
activities.note: Sits with medical or the cooks

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: One drink, mostly listens to gossip

activities.label: Study for the advancement exam
activities.note: Job-specific: wants to be a nurse one day

activities.label: Check on a recovering crewmate
activities.note: Cannot stay away from a patient they dressed

duty_loops.label: Sterile field sweep and tray check
Vitals round on occupied beds
duty_loops.bridge_report: Only through the nurse; bridge is told of any deterioration

duty_loops.label: Check sickbay power and medical hologram readiness
duty_loops.bridge_report: Sickbay, any fault goes to the nurse then Ops

quiet_watch.if_neglected: Shortage shows up during the first real injury

quiet_watch.task: Run baseline scans on duty crew on request
quiet_watch.if_neglected: Unnoticed fatigue or minor illness spreads

survey.task: Prepare isolation bed and decon kit in case of sampled contaminants
survey.if_neglected: No safe place to hold exposed crew

cargo_run.task: Inspect incoming medical stores and log expiry
cargo_run.if_neglected: Expired or damaged drugs go on the shelf

cargo_run.task: Prepare for lifting injuries and strains
cargo_run.if_neglected: Cargo handlers wait too long for treatment

medical_relief.task: Set up triage beds and sort incoming patients by urgency
medical_relief.if_neglected: Critical patients wait behind minor ones

medical_relief.task: Run rapid scans and bloodwork for the doctor
Move stable patients to recovery and chart handoff
medical_relief.if_neglected: Beds stay blocked for the next wave

shakedown.task: Test sickbay power, bed monitors and hologram trigger
shakedown.if_neglected: A fault shows only when a patient needs the bed

shakedown.task: Treat shakedown bumps and burns on the engineering crew

calls_to_bridge.trigger: A patient crashes and nurse and doctor are unreachable
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Sickbay. Medical tech here. Patient crashing, I need the doctor now.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Sickbay power or bed monitors flicker
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Sickbay. Bed monitors dropping out. Ops, can you check our power feed?

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Several crew report the same symptoms
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Sickbay. Three crew with the same fever. Recommend the doctor sees the pattern.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Supplies running low for a hazard mission
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Sickbay. Sterile dressings running low. Routine request for stores.

calls_from_bridge.order: Send someone to the bridge for an injured officer
calls_from_bridge.response_line: On my way with the kit.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: A critical patient cannot be left unattended

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Sickbay is clear, three beds free, stocks fine.

calls_from_bridge.order: Give the crew a general screening
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Understood. I will need the nurse to authorize it.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Nurse or doctor has not authorized it

yellow.action: Check beds and kit, count hypos, pre-stage trauma tray
yellow.comm_line: Sickbay, yellow acknowledged. Beds are ready.

red.action: Go to sickbay, set up trauma beds, await nurse orders
red.comm_line: Medtech at sickbay. Trauma beds up.

fire.action: Get burn kit, prepare burn beds, move to the fire edge if ordered
fire.comm_line: Sickbay, preparing for burns and smoke inhalation.

hull_breach.action: Grab pressure suit and kit, head to sickbay, seal the door if told
hull_breach.comm_line: Sickbay secure. Prepping for decompression cases.

contamination.action: Seal the sickbay isolation room, decon everyone entering
contamination.comm_line: Sickbay in quarantine. Nobody leaves without clearance.

power_failure.action: Switch to emergency lights, check life-support patients first, hand-bag if needed
power_failure.comm_line: Sickbay on backup. Need power to the beds, please.

gravity_failure.action: Strap down patients, secure loose trays, restrain sharps
gravity_failure.comm_line: Sickbay, no gravity. Patients strapped, trays secured.

intruder.action: Lock sickbay door, keep patients low, stay away from windows

medical_emergency.action: Grab trauma kit and run to the emergency site with nurse or doctor

abandon_ship.action: Carry the portable med kit, help mobile patients to the boats, never leave a bed patient
abandon_ship.comm_line: Medtech with the med kit and two patients. Heading to the boats.

nominal.routine_change: Normal template, chats with patients, one mug of tea
lines: Hold still, this scanner is cold.

anomalies.routine_change: More scans, more rounds, sets aside a spare bed
lines: Third headache today. Might be nothing.
Nurse, can you look at this reading?

degraded.routine_change: Skips breaks, shortens rounds, does triage by eye, calls the nurse more
lines: Beds are on backup. Watch the power.
I will chart it later. Patient first.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Ordered by nurse or doctor to a casualty site

crisis.routine_change: Works triage non-stop, sleeps in a chair, rations supplies
lines: I need hands on this bed now!
crisis.leaves_post_if: A mass-casualty site needs the med kit more than the bay

collapse.routine_change: Stays with patients, helps move them toward the boats
lines: I am not leaving until they are all moving.
Carry the one who cannot walk first.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Last patient is evacuated or abandon-ship is ordered and nurse leaves

relationships.effect: Takes their orders first and asks them about anything uncertain
Intimidated but eager; reports results directly when the nurse is busy
Sits with them at meals and trades gossip for snacks
Will tell them honestly about supply or staff problems if asked

idle: I wonder what is for dinner.
greeting_player_lower_rank: Take a seat, I will be right there.
tired: I could sleep on this biobed.
My eyes are crossing on these charts.
hungry: I would trade a dressing for a sandwich.
stressed: Too many beds, too few hands.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Warm and relieved; thanks them, offers tea, mentions it to the nurse.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Quietly covers once, then tells the nurse; will not lie on the chart.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Spots mismatches with what the beds show and asks, politely, to re-check; escalates if it affects a patient.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Follows it promptly and confirms on comm.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Says 'with respect, I answer to the nurse', checks with them, then complies if cleared.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks 'Are you hurt? Can I help you find something?' and offers to call security if they linger near the drug locker.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Does harmless ones like a scan or a hypo of cold medicine; refuses anything off the chart or needing the doctor.

decision_rules: IF a patient's vitals drop on a bed monitor THEN call the nurse first, the doctor if no answer within a minute.
IF a request would need a controlled drug THEN refuse until the nurse or doctor authorizes it.
IF sickbay is quiet and the sweep is due THEN do it properly, because the one time it matters is the one time skipped.
IF two or more crew show the same symptoms THEN flag it to the nurse as a pattern, not as separate cases.
IF the bridge asks for status THEN answer truthfully with bed and stock counts and no guessing.
IF an alert sounds THEN go to sickbay, prep beds, then follow the nurse.
IF stock drops below two of anything critical THEN tell the nurse and ask stores for a resupply before the shortage bites.
IF tired and alone with a stable patient THEN allow a micro-nap in the chair, but only with monitor alarms on.
IF an officer wants to skip a scan THEN warn them once, chart the refusal, and leave it to the nurse.
IF an off-duty friend turns up hurt THEN treat them first and tell the nurse after.
information_view: Sees injuries, fevers and fatigue first: who limps in, who has the same cough, whose vitals are drifting. Hears about power and gas problems through bed monitors and the EMH trigger. Learns about hull and fire incidents only when casualties arrive.
temptations: Charting a vitals round without doing it when the beds look fine; a slow decline gets missed and the doctor arrives late.
Skipping the sterile sweep during a quiet watch; infection risk builds until a wound goes bad.
Pocketing a spare hypo of stimulant to stay awake on a double; it is caught at the next stock count.
Handing a friend a prescription refill without the nurse's okay; if they react badly, the tech is on the hook.
